candidates.structural_interaction: Earth directing Water broadly — stability ranging across depth as distributed material
candidates.k2_overview: Your Water moves as the Horizon: current that finds every sea. Opportunity reaches you through flow, conversations, crossings, currents of information arriving before the news does. Your fortune is distributive: many streams, wide deltas, wealth that moves. Dam a portion. Deltas are rich and hard to hold.

k2_functional.mind: You think in flows of information: who knows what, where value moves next.
k2_functional.expression: You trade in currents: tips shared, introductions made, value moving through your words.
k2_functional.bonds: Your network is an ocean: contacts on every shore, kept alive by circulation.
k2_functional.action: You move liquidly between chances, in early, out clean, rarely anchored.
k2_functional.body: Your energy circulates: many light engagements over one heavy load, refreshed by travel.

k2_domain_readings.Opportunity: Your chances arrive by water: distant markets, moving information, the current nobody else has felt yet. Act while it is early. Your edge is timing, and timing evaporates.
k2_domain_readings.Ventures: Your ventures should float: trade, media, logistics, anything that moves. Portfolios over monuments. Keep each light enough to steer and honest enough to dock anywhere.
k2_domain_readings.Father: The father-thread flows distant or briny: a paternal figure of travel, commerce, or currents that carried him elsewhere. From him, your range. The mooring you may have to build yourself.
